snippet.title: Sitting Ducks - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Sitting Ducks on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4397060/Sitting_Ducks

Welcome to our upcoming game! We're creating a 1-6 player co-op armageddon game where you build ridiculous structures in an attempt to survive world-ending disasters.

Build, panic, work together (or don't) and remember, don't be a Sitting Duck.

Follow our socials 👇
